prompt: An instructional comparison image made of THREE EQUAL PANELS stacked vertically, separated by thin white gaps, each panel one third of the image height. Every panel is the same EXTREME CLOSE-UP, seen from directly above: the top surface of a wrist fills the panel as skin background, and two fingertips of the same hand enter the panel, a THUMB tip from the lower left and an INDEX fingertip from the upper right, both with clearly visible fingernails, each fingertip about one third of the panel width. The panels differ ONLY in how the two fingertips meet. TOP panel: the index fingertip lies across the thumb tip, the two nails clearly overlapping. MIDDLE panel: the two fingertips just touch end to end, nail meeting nail, no overlap and no gap. BOTTOM panel: the two fingertips do not reach each other, a wide gap of bare wrist skin about one fingertip wide between them.
